comparison.calculator: One/two-byte receive storage and fixed descriptor; no allocation.
comparison.model: Each step O(1), at most two data reads; explicit hardware flag acknowledgements; unresponsive hardware has no finite quiescence promise.
comparison.target: Fixed selected-register operations with bounded interrupt exclusion; no physical throughput or interrupt latency bound.
comparison.measurement: Host-side phase/address and effect/retry oracles; no target dependency.

limits: Emitted section sizes and compiler local frames are observed; local frames are not complete call-chain/interrupt peak stack.
No physical I2C waveform, DMA completion latency, energy or throughput measured.
Different optimization/targets require rebuilding; these are not portable golden costs.
